space: galley unit space (HB_Galley): Unity metres, y up, unit front +z; camera = the eye (x right, y up, z forward)
suit_state: unsuited only: helmet off, bare face. Never play these clips with the suit or helmet on. AstronautHandsPresenter shows the suit gloves only while the suit is worn. The left hand in the frames is the approved glove rig, darkened like the separate work-glove instance (MAT_Cargo_WorkGloves) to mark unsuited use; the unsuited WORK body (A7_BodyFit02_WORK, bare hands) can be driven to the same targets (index_tip_*, clasp_target_*).
timing: presentation only: one staged bite (meal, 3.4 s) or sip (drink, 4.1 s). Not the simulated meal duration, amount, water volume or award moment; Core owns those.

carry.status: missing pose: no approved glove pose carries a pouch; the props follow the path a carrying hand would take
carry.why: Grip closes round a 34 mm tube. The meal body is 125 x 150 x 28 mm and the drink body 95 x 150 x 24 mm. The drink adapter (42 x 26 x 17 mm) sits between the straw (up) and the body (down): a fist across it is cut by both (fit.rejected_adapter_fist), and a fist along the straw spans 93.7 mm while the free neck between the top seal and the clamp is 24 mm (open) to 44 mm (closed).

missing_anchor.pose: Clasp for R and L: thumb pad opposed to the index and middle finger pads, aperture 24 mm (drink) to 28 mm (meal)
missing_anchor.point: R_ClaspPoint / L_ClaspPoint: the middle of that aperture, given in the Hand frame like the rig's Grip and Press reference points
missing_anchor.target: clasp_target_* in every frame: the pouch's grip anchor (MealGrip / DrinkGrip, (0, -0.020, 0) in prop space) with the prop's axes: +z label side (thumb), -z back (fingers), +y up the pouch
missing_anchor.then: hand_world = clasp_target @ inverse(ClaspPoint frame in Hand); R_Arm (camera space) = inverse(eye) @ hand_world @ inverse(Clasp wrist rotation)

rejected_adapter_fist.what: R Grip fist round the drink adapter (fist axis across the pouch), pouch at the hold pose
